X_SCT_S1E01_S01_VIS.text: Open intimately on coffee, drapes, footsteps and pauses. Hold the ordinary morning long enough for Alex's attention to make it feel newly visible.

X_SCT_S1E01_S02_VIS.text: Pattern Space begins elegant and exhilarating. Alex traces, aligns and connects ideas with fluency; visual density accumulates until the same logic starts to constrain the frame.

X_SCT_S1E02_S01_VIS.text: Build the city from repeated commuter pathways, footsteps, doors and tunnel sound. Alex and Mira repeatedly find each other in the flow, then slip slightly out of sync.

X_SCT_S1E02_S02_VIS.text: Keep the conflict small and domestic. Mira describes feeling overwhelmed; Alex answers with a sequence of practical fixes. End when she makes clear that not everything she tells him is a problem statement.

X_SCT_S1E03_S01_VIS.text: Begin as sincere confession. Let Mira receive the praise until the comparisons accumulate; the turn lands when she understands the stabilizing role Alex has assigned her.

X_SCT_S1E03_S02_VIS.text: Play the breakup quietly. Alex keeps reformulating the conflict in search of the correct explanation; Mira stops participating in the analysis and leaves. End on the Sun Comes Through motif distant and unresolved.

X_SCT_S1E04_S01_VIS.text: Use reflections, habitual routes, familiar corners and absent spaces to trigger Alex's physical expectation of Mira. Memory is carried by ordinary city objects and movement.

X_SCT_S1E04_S02_VIS.text: Let the rehearsal room expand theatrically into posters, arena light and imagined crowd scale, then collapse back to the empty room as Alex confronts the life he expected to have.

X_SCT_S1E05_S01_VIS.text: Center Mira as the workshop leader. Participants hesitate, miss cues, laugh, try again and gradually build shared form from breath, claps and movement as the taped floor grid is removed.

X_SCT_S1E05_S02_VIS.text: Hold care and boundary together. Alex asks whether Mira will still catch him; she remains compassionate without accepting responsibility for keeping him upright. They part without reconciliation.

X_SCT_S1E06_S01_VIS.text: Use split montage to show Mira's workshop becoming real while Alex lives through the separation. The key Alex action is drafting a reassurance-seeking message and choosing not to send it.

X_SCT_S1E06_S02_VIS.text: Leave the question 'what was the point?' unanswered. End with Alex erasing the last diagram and leaving the board blank.

X_SCT_S1E07_S01_VIS.text: Alex begins by counting beats and steps. As the number builds, movement outruns calculation and he stays engaged without steering; the shift is physical and incremental.

X_SCT_S1E07_S02_VIS.text: Keep the café encounter small. Coffee, smell, taste and shared humor reopen familiarity; neither character forces the moment to define the relationship.

X_SCT_S1E08_S01_VIS.text: Intercut screens, sidewalks, apartments, transit and multiple generations while the spoken section widens the frame. Let 'watch, notice and wonder' emerge as the scene's final active language.

X_SCT_S1E08_S02_VIS.text: Make the resolution observable in action. Alex asks to join, does not conduct, and offers the unfinished score to the room. Participants fill the blank measures before Mira moves toward him. Morning light reaches the full ensemble.
